items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: But, anyway, we were in the Avey Hotel playing, and Woods said, tell that fellow to break his clarinet.

ctx.x: MR. WHALEY: -- New England Conservatory. See, so I got him this job, give him some money. And we used to play up in the balcony, like, at the Avey Hotel. And then I had another job where I had -- I think I had a couple more musicians.
But, anyway, we were in the Avey Hotel playing, and Woods said, tell that fellow to break his clarinet. You know what I mean?
